acceptance: The fork's QuestDB generator writes date literals cast to or compared with dates zero padded, or the equivalent fix, with a QuestDB engine test in fork CI showing rows on the bounds.
TPC-DS Q16/Q94/Q95 on QuestDB return the same rows as DuckDB on data with rows in range (e.g. the two-warehouse setup used for #3426).
ClickHouse handling of unpadded date literals is confirmed by an executed chDB or ClickHouse test.
A corpus diff lists every changed QuestDB query.
description: Found while fixing the same defect on SQLite (BenchBox #3426, fork 30.24.0.13). QuestDB at 127.0.0.1:8812 returns NULL for CAST('1999-5-01' AS DATE); dsqgen emits unpadded months ([YEAR]-[MONTH]-01), and QuestDB TPC-DS Q16 carries DATEADD('d', 60, CAST('2000-3-01' AS DATE)), so date filters match nothing. The fork's QuestDB generator was left unchanged. ClickHouse readDateText accepts YYYY-M-D per src/IO/ReadHelpers.h, but no ClickHouse engine ran to confirm it (chDB does not load on macOS). No QuestDB bundle is published.
